    • TierList

      public TierList(String name, ListTierElement unranked, List<Tier> tiers)
      Constructs a TierList instance. The tier list instance will be constructed with the given lists parameters.
      Parameters:
      name - the tier list's name
      unranked - elements to rank
      tiers - tiers to associate
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is blank

    • TierList

      public TierList(String name, ListTierElement unranked)
      Constructs TierList instance. The tier list instance will be constructed with the given lists parameters. It's initial 'ranked' contents will be set to empty.
      Parameters:
      name - the tier list's name
      unranked - elements to rank
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is blank

    • TierList

      public TierList(ListTierElement unranked)
      Constructs a TierList instance. The tier list instance will be constructed with the given lists parameters. The name will be set to DEFAULT_TIERLIST_NAME; It's initial 'ranked' contents will be set to empty
      Parameters:
      unranked - elements to rank
